catalysts.headline: One aggregator (MarketBeat) flags an unspecified 'key catalyst' for Corning dated Nov 11, 2026; no content, detail, or second-source corroboration was found this session

Multiple analysts revised price targets, apparently following a Q3 2026 earnings report: UBS lowered target to $192 from $201 (kept Buy); Morgan Stanley lowered target to $155 from $165 (Equal-weight); Truist lowered target to $175 from $182 (kept Buy); Barclays raised target to $132 from $129 (Equal-weight)

Corning reports Q3 2026 results: GAAP net sales $4.855B (+13.6% YoY, below ~$5.05B consensus on a GAAP basis) but core (non-GAAP) sales of $5.08B beat an adjusted estimate of $5.03B; core EPS ~$0.91 beat; Optical Communications segment sales $2.38B (+44% YoY) on AI/fiber demand; four new long-term multibillion-dollar customer agreements including Verizon and AT&T
catalysts.impact: Q4 2026 guidance: core sales $5.2B-$5.3B, core EPS $0.96-$1.00; shares reported up 4%+ in the session after results, and some analysts (e.g., JPMorgan) raised price targets

catalysts.headline: Corning reported Q3 2026 results, which the company says exceeded its own guidance: GAAP sales $4.86B, GAAP gross margin 37.3%, GAAP operating margin 18.8%, GAAP EPS $0.78, operating cash flow $1.06B; core sales $5.08B (+19% YoY, above the $4.9-5.0B guided range) and core EPS $0.91 (above the $0.85-0.89 guided range). The company said it signed four new long-term, multibillion-dollar customer agreements during the quarter, including with Verizon and AT&T. It issued Q4 2026 guidance of core sales $5.2-5.3B and core EPS $0.96-1.00.

Corning enters $2B at-the-market equity offering agreement with Goldman Sachs; no fixed price or share count disclosed
catalysts.impact: Stock closed down 13.70% on the session; sympathy weakness also hit optical/AI-supply-chain peers (Coherent -11%, Lumentum -9%, Fabrinet -6%)

catalysts.headline: Corning entered an Equity Distribution Agreement with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC to sell up to $2,000,000,000 of common stock at-the-market under its existing Form S-3 shelf, with proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes (capex, optical-capacity investment, debt reduction, dividends). Goldman receives a 1% commission on gross proceeds; no fixed price or share count was set.
catalysts.impact: Shares fell sharply on the news (reports range from -12% to -13.6%, one calling it the worst S&P 500 performer that day) — see conflicts

catalysts.headline: Corning reported Q2 2026 results (non-GAAP EPS $0.78, beating consensus) and issued Q3 2026 guidance of core sales $4.9-5.0B and core EPS $0.85-0.89; Optical Communications sales reportedly rose sharply on generative-AI infrastructure demand (Enterprise Networks segment up as much as 65% per one source).
catalysts.impact: Stock reaction disagreed across sources: -2.5% in one report, -11.2% in another, both attributed to Q3 guidance concerns

conflicts: Revenue framing: Webull/Barchart report a GAAP revenue MISS ($4.86B vs $5.05B consensus) while Zacks/StockTwits report a non-GAAP 'core sales' BEAT ($5.08B vs $5.03B adjusted estimate) — both can be true simultaneously, but headline framing across sources directly conflicts on whether Q3 2026 was a 'miss' or a 'beat'

Price: Marketchameleon shows $106.13 (market cap $91.42B) as of 2026-11-06, while massive.com shows a HIGHER price of $125.04 (market cap $106.8B) as of 2026-10-23 — i.e., sources imply the stock fell roughly 15% between Oct 23 and Nov 6, which is hard to reconcile with other reporting that shares rose 4%+ in the session immediately after the Oct 27 earnings beat
Several MarketBeat/AAII pages date the Q3 2026 earnings release to 2026-07-28, which matches Q2 timing and appears to be a date error; the 2026-10-27 date was used instead
notes: Year-to-date share performance was reported as up more than 60% as of early November 2026 per StockTwits, consistent with the AI-driven Optical Communications growth narrative, though this could not be cross-verified against the conflicting price points above.
